title: Loop+ Membership Billing, Declined Renewals and Payment Hold
content:
Billing operations note for Loop+ Membership fees.

**1. Rule.** The fee of the plan is charged on the day after the trial ends and then every billing cycle on the next billing date. A declined renewal puts the membership in payment hold with benefits kept, and the charge is retried every retry interval up to the retry count; a successful retry or updated card returns it to active with the paid period running from the original renewal date, and exhausted retries lapse it. A lapsed buyer may rejoin within the reactivation window, paying a fresh fee and keeping tenure. A fee change applies only to renewals after the price change notice days.

**2. Charges.** Each Loop+ Membership fee charge covers one billing period and is recorded as a first charge, a renewal or a plan switch charge, with the first day of the period it covers. When a membership becomes paid and active it carries a paid-through date (the last day covered by the fees paid) and a next billing date (the next renewal date). The membership fees on an account are the fee charges paid net of fee refunds.

**3. Declined renewal.** The first declined attempt at a renewal charge (attempt 1, the original charge) puts an active membership into payment hold; the next billing date then shows the date of the next retry. While the membership is in payment hold its benefits are kept. The charge is retried every retry interval, up to the retry count.

**4. Outcome of the retries.**

| Event during payment hold | Result |
|---|---|
| A retry succeeds | the membership returns to active; the paid period runs from the original renewal date |
| The buyer updates the card and the charge succeeds | the membership returns to active; the paid period runs from the original renewal date |
| All retries fail | the membership lapses and benefits stop; the date benefits stopped is recorded as its end date |

**5. Rejoining.** A lapsed buyer may rejoin within the reactivation window, paying a fresh fee and keeping tenure.

**6. Fee changes.** A fee change applies only to renewals after the price change notice days.

**Worked timeline (hypothetical dates, with a retry interval of 4 days and a retry count of 3 taken as inputs).** A monthly renewal falls due on 10 June and the charge is declined; the membership enters payment hold with benefits kept. Retries follow every 4 days: 14 June, 18 June and 22 June.
- If the retry on 18 June succeeds, the membership returns to active and the paid period runs from 10 June, the original renewal date, not from 18 June.
- If the retry on 22 June also fails, the retries are exhausted and the membership lapses; benefits stop.
